Name: Jahziel
Summary: Son of Naphtali, named among the sons of Naphtali by Bilhah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:13: Son of Naphtali, named among the sons of Naphtali by Bilhah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jahziel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
